chunks: I am myself within the army.

So, refer to me their high-handedness and any hardship which is caused by them and which you cannot avert except through Allāh and through me. I shall then avert it with the help of Allāh, if He so wills.

key_terms.أَمْرِهِمْ: their affairs or matters (of the soldiers)
key_terms.مَظَالِمَكُمْ: grievances or injustices suffered by you

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali instruct the army officers to do regarding grievances?
ai.summary: In this directive to his army officers, Imam Ali (AS) establishes a mechanism for accountability by inviting reports of 'mazalim' (grievances) and burdens that exceeded the soldiers' capacity to bear or resolve independently. This reflects the Shia understanding of the Imam’s role not merely as a military commander but as the ultimate arbiter of justice, intervening directly when administrative structures fail. The phrase 'except by God and me' underscores the theological concept of divine authority channeled through the Imam, ensuring that justice is served with heavenly support.
